title: fix(app-shell): an authored FormView.modalSize sizes the console create/edit modal
body:
Fixes #12803
Clause-②: no

**Landing record:** an authored `FormView.modalSize` now wins on the console create/edit modal on desktop; mobile stays full-screen.

## What changed

- `resolveFormViewLayout` (`packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`) copies the default form view's `modalSize` when the spec's `FormView.modalSize` enum accepts it. The enum is read from `FormViewSchema` itself (`FormViewSchema.shape.modalSize`), so no second copy of it lives here. The copy is independent of `sections`: a form view can size the dialog without curating its fields.
- New `resolveRecordFormModalLayout(objectDef, derivedSize)` in the same file states the precedence instead of leaving it to spread order: (1) a derived `size: 'full'` (the phone posture of `deriveRecordFlowSurface`) stays `'full'`; (2) otherwise the authored `modalSize` wins; (3) otherwise no `modalSize` key at all, so `ModalForm` sizes the dialog itself as before.
- `AppContent.tsx`, create/edit `ModalForm` schema build only: the two spreads (derived `'full'`, then `...resolveFormViewLayout(...)`) become one `...resolveRecordFormModalLayout(formObjectDef, deriveRecordFlowSurface(...).size)`. Before, a naively copied `modalSize` would have overridden a derived `'full'`, because the layout spread came second.
- `ModalForm.tsx` and the spec docblock are untouched, as ruled.
- Changeset `.changeset/12803-form-modal-size.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`). `resolveFormViewLayout` / `FormViewModalLayout` are not on the package root entry (`src/index.ts`), so no published export gains a member, and Clause-② stays no.

## Tests

- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/recordFormModalSize-12803.test.ts` (unit): every spec enum value is copied; an off-enum value (`md`, `auto`, a number) is not; the precedence holds on desktop (authored wins) and mobile (derived `full` stays); CONTROL desktop and mobile with nothing authored give the same result as before, compared with `toStrictEqual`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.formViewModalSize-12803.test.tsx` (dom, real `AppContent` mount, the harness of `AppContent.recordDialogInterimBound-12521`): (a) authored `lg` reaches the `ModalForm` schema for create, edit and child-create, and the real dialog opens at `sm:max-w-2xl`, not the derived `sm:max-w-5xl`; (b) CONTROL, nothing authored: no `modalSize` key on the schema, and the real dialog keeps `sm:max-w-5xl`; (c) phone: below `sm` the authored-`lg` dialog carries exactly the classes of the unsized one (the full-screen sheet), with no `max-w-` cap.
- Ablation, run once on the committed fix: deleting the `layout.modalSize = authoredSize;` line through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `cec1174494ae` to `ccf88599d3df`) turned 11 of 22 tests red, every (a) pin; the CONTROL and phone pins stayed green. The restore was proven by blob hash (`cec1174494ae` equals the HEAD blob) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Gates (at `4f106100c`)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the new tests): exit 0.
- vitest: the four touched or related files: 79 passed. The 65 test files in `packages/app-shell`, `apps/console` that import `recordFormNavigation`, `AppContent` or `useActionModal`: 560 passed. **NOT MEASURED: the whole `packages/app-shell/` directory.** Reason: with `--maxWorkers=1` it printed nothing for 30 minutes under the lock, so I stopped it and left the full package run to CI.
- Lint, narrowed to the 4 changed source/test files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` gave 4 files, 0 errors (warnings only, existing `no-explicit-any` style). The population is the changed files. The repo's `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`navigation.size` versus `FormView.modalSize` (measured):** the installed `@objectstack/spec` `deriveRecordFlowSurface` reads only the authorable field count and the `viewport` option. It never reads `navigation.size`, and `AppContent` reads no `navigation` for this modal either. So an authored `navigation.size` has no effect on the create/edit modal, before or after this change. When it disagrees with `FormView.modalSize`, the form view's own `modalSize` applies. No new precedence key and no fallback were added.
- **Mobile:** this host calls `deriveRecordFlowSurface` with no `viewport`, so in the console the derived size is always `auto`. The phone's full-screen modal is `ModalForm`'s unprefixed sheet classes, and every `modalSizeClasses` entry is `sm:`-prefixed. An authored size therefore cannot reach a phone (pin (c)). The explicit derived-`full` rule in `resolveRecordFormModalLayout` covers a future caller that passes `viewport: 'mobile'`.
- **A1, the other reader of `resolveFormViewLayout`:** `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` (an action-opened object form) spreads `...viewLayout` and then writes `modalSize: d.size`. The explicit key, even when `undefined`, overrides the copied value, so the action modal's size is still the action's own `size`, unchanged. Letting an action modal with no `size` fall back to the form view's `modalSize` would be a one-line change in that file. That file is outside this card's file surface, so I did not make the change and left it for the seat to decide.
- **For the objectstack `domain:spec` seat:** `FormView.modalSize` now reaches the console create/edit modal on desktop. The `deriveRecordFlowSurface` docblock may list `modalSize` again among the config that wins.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
